_comment: Copy this file to config/keys.json (gitignored) and replace with real keys. Map each shared API key to a label (used in logs and /health). Optionally add a 'configs' allowlist to restrict which configs that key may see and use; omit it (or leave empty) to allow all configs. Clients pass the key in the WebSocket hello frame (and as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' for GET /configs).
